scope: Explicit network-writer delegation and handover for AGENT_NETWORK_INTERFACES: forward grant/handover commands with guards, packaging tests, and an installed-setup.py staged E2E on OrbStack; production runtime has no writer and was returned unchanged

implementation.grant: setup.py grant-network-writer --interfaces --operator: agent stopped, journal settled, current writer empty, no confirmed state; interface names validated (non-empty entries, unique, Linux-bounded); writes the exact list and re-checks
implementation.handover: setup.py handover-network-writer --operator [--discard-config]: agent stopped, journal settled; refuses when there is neither writer nor confirmed state; by default keeps /etc/netplan/90-yofc-managed.yaml so the system continues from the last confirmed configuration, archives confirmed.json plus a receipt (schema yofc.agent.network-writer-handover.v1: interfaces, revision, confirmedYamlSha256, keptManagedConfigFile, operator) under network/handovers/<n>/, deletes the live confirmed.json and clears AGENT_NETWORK_INTERFACES, which unblocks purge; --discard-config deletes the managed file only when it matches the confirmed content byte for byte (drift refuses)
implementation.guards: package lifecycle still blocked while a writer is installed; unsettle transactions refuse both grant and handover; a second grant requires handing the current writer over first

new: grant requires clean state and valid names (empty entries/invalid/duplicate refused without mutation)
keep-config handover archives state, keeps the system file, releases purge
discard requires exact file match and refuses drift
unsettled transaction and empty-state handover refused
